   105	/**
   106	 * Snapshot whether a task is mid CI-wait (safe to resume without worker launch).
   107	 */
   108	export function detectAwaitingCi(core, taskId) {
   109	  const candidates = core.store.listCandidatesForTask(taskId);
   110	  const live = candidates
   111	    .filter((c) => c.status !== CANDIDATE_STATUS.SUPERSEDED)
   112	    .sort((a, b) => String(b.created_at).localeCompare(String(a.created_at)));
   113	  const candidate = live[0] || null;
   114	  if (!candidate) {
   115	    return { awaiting_ci: false, candidate: null, run: null };
   116	  }
   117	  const run = core.store.getRun(candidate.factory_run_id);
   118	  if (!run || run.status !== RUN_STATUS.SUCCEEDED) {
   119	    return { awaiting_ci: false, candidate, run };
   120	  }
   121	  const verification = candidate.verification_ref
   122	    ? core.store.getVerification(candidate.verification_ref)
   123	    : null;
   124	  if (
   125	    verification &&
   126	    verification.result === VERIFICATION_RESULT.PASS &&
   127	    !verification.invalidated_at
   128	  ) {
   129	    return { awaiting_ci: false, candidate, run, verification };
   130	  }
   131	  const pendingCi =
   132	    !candidate.ci_status ||
   133	    candidate.ci_status === 'pending' ||
   134	    candidate.ci_status === 'unknown' ||
   135	    (verification && verification.result === VERIFICATION_RESULT.BLOCKED);
   136	  return {
   137	    awaiting_ci: Boolean(pendingCi),
   138	    candidate,
   139	    run,
   140	    verification,
   141	  };
   142	}
   143	
   144	/**
   145	 * Poll GitHub until CI for the exact candidate SHA is terminal, or bound expires.
   146	 */
   147	export async function waitForExactCandidateCi(
   148	  core,
   149	  {
   150	    candidate_id,
   151	    githubClient,
   152	    poll_ms = 5000,
   153	    timeout_ms = 20 * 60 * 1000,
   154	    sleepFn = defaultSleep,
   155	    nowFn = () => Date.now(),
   156	  } = {}
   157	) {
   158	  if (!githubClient) {
   159	    throw new BuilderCoreError(
   160	      'githubClient required for exact CI wait',
   161	      'GITHUB_REQUIRED'
   162	    );
   163	  }
   164	  if (!Number.isFinite(poll_ms) || poll_ms < 1) {
   165	    throw new BuilderCoreError('ci poll_ms must be >= 1', 'INVALID_CI_POLL');
   166	  }
   167	  if (!Number.isFinite(timeout_ms) || timeout_ms < 1) {
   168	    throw new BuilderCoreError('ci timeout_ms must be >= 1', 'INVALID_CI_TIMEOUT');
   169	  }
   170	
   171	  let candidate = core.store.getCandidate(candidate_id);
   172	  if (!candidate) {
   173	    throw new BuilderCoreError(
   174	      `unknown candidate_id: ${candidate_id}`,
   175	      'UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE'
   176	    );
   177	  }
   178	  const boundSha = assertCommitSha(candidate.commit_sha);
   179	  if (!candidate.branch) {
   180	    throw new BuilderCoreError(
   181	      'candidate missing branch for CI wait',
   182	      'MISSING_BRANCH'
   183	    );
   184	  }
   185	  if (candidate.pr_number == null) {
   186	    throw new BuilderCoreError(
   187	      'candidate missing pr_number for CI wait',
   188	      'MISSING_PR'
   189	    );
   190	  }
   191	
   192	  const started_at = nowIso();
   193	  const deadline = nowFn() + timeout_ms;
   194	  let polls = 0;
   195	  let lastEvidence = null;
   196	
   197	  core.store.appendEvent({
   198	    task_id: candidate.task_id,
   199	    factory_run_id: candidate.factory_run_id,
   200	    event_type: EVENT_TYPE.CI_WAIT_STARTED,
   201	    payload: {
   202	      candidate_id,
   203	      commit_sha: boundSha,
   204	      branch: candidate.branch,
   205	      pr_number: candidate.pr_number,
   206	      poll_ms,
   207	      timeout_ms,
   208	      started_at,
   209	    },
   210	  });
   211	
   212	  while (nowFn() < deadline) {
   213	    polls += 1;
   214	    candidate = core.store.getCandidate(candidate_id);
   215	    const sha = assertCommitSha(candidate.commit_sha);
   216	    if (sha !== boundSha) {
   217	      // Bound SHA changed under us — fail closed for this wait.
   218	      const evidence = buildCiEvidence({
   219	        candidate,
   220	        sha,
   221	        pr: null,
   222	        summary: null,
   223	        checkRuns: [],
   224	        started_at,
   225	        finished_at: nowIso(),
   226	        polls,
   227	        outcome: CI_WAIT_OUTCOME.HEAD_CHANGED,
   228	      });
   229	      core.store.appendEvent({
   230	        task_id: candidate.task_id,
   231	        factory_run_id: candidate.factory_run_id,
   232	        event_type: EVENT_TYPE.CI_WAIT_INVALIDATED,
   233	        payload: evidence,
   234	      });
   235	      return {
   236	        outcome: CI_WAIT_OUTCOME.HEAD_CHANGED,
   237	        evidence,
   238	        candidate,
   239	      };
   240	    }
   241	
   242	    const commit = await githubClient.getCommit(sha);
   243	    if (!commit?.sha || commit.sha !== sha) {
   244	      throw new BuilderCoreError(
   245	        `github commit sha mismatch during CI wait: expected ${sha} got ${commit?.sha}`,
   246	        'SHA_MISMATCH'
   247	      );
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    const pr = await githubClient.getPullRequest(candidate.pr_number);
   251	    if (pr.head_ref !== candidate.branch) {
   252	      const evidence = buildCiEvidence({
   253	        candidate,
   254	        sha,
   255	        pr,
   256	        summary: null,
   257	        checkRuns: [],
   258	        started_at,
   259	        finished_at: nowIso(),
   260	        polls,
   261	        outcome: CI_WAIT_OUTCOME.PR_MISMATCH,
   262	      });
   263	      if (candidate.verification_ref) {
   264	        invalidateVerification(core, candidate.verification_ref, 'ci_pr_branch_mismatch');
   265	      }
   266	      if (candidate.review_ref) {
   267	        invalidateReview(core, candidate.review_ref, 'ci_pr_branch_mismatch');
   268	      }
   269	      core.store.appendEvent({
   270	        task_id: candidate.task_id,
   271	        factory_run_id: candidate.factory_run_id,
   272	        event_type: EVENT_TYPE.CI_WAIT_FINISHED,
   273	        payload: evidence,
   274	      });
   275	      return {
   276	        outcome: CI_WAIT_OUTCOME.PR_MISMATCH,
   277	        evidence,
   278	        candidate,
   279	      };
   280	    }
   281	    if (pr.head_sha !== sha) {
   282	      if (candidate.verification_ref) {
   283	        invalidateVerification(core, candidate.verification_ref, 'ci_pr_head_changed');
   284	      }
   285	      if (candidate.review_ref) {
   286	        invalidateReview(core, candidate.review_ref, 'ci_pr_head_changed');
   287	      }
   288	      const evidence = buildCiEvidence({
   289	        candidate,
   290	        sha,
   291	        pr,
   292	        summary: null,
   293	        checkRuns: [],
   294	        started_at,
   295	        finished_at: nowIso(),
   296	        polls,
   297	        outcome: CI_WAIT_OUTCOME.HEAD_CHANGED,
   298	      });
   299	      core.store.appendEvent({
   300	        task_id: candidate.task_id,
   301	        factory_run_id: candidate.factory_run_id,
   302	        event_type: EVENT_TYPE.CI_WAIT_INVALIDATED,
   303	        payload: {
   304	          ...evidence,
   305	          new_head_sha: pr.head_sha,
   306	          bound_sha: sha,
   307	        },
   308	      });
   309	      return {
   310	        outcome: CI_WAIT_OUTCOME.HEAD_CHANGED,
   311	        evidence: { ...evidence, new_head_sha: pr.head_sha },
   312	        candidate,
   313	        new_head_sha: pr.head_sha,
   314	      };
   315	    }
   316	
   317	    // Exact-SHA CI only — never query another SHA's checks.
   318	    const checkRuns = await githubClient.getCheckRunsForCommit(sha);
   319	    const combined = await githubClient.getCombinedStatusForCommit(sha);
   320	    const summary = githubClient.summarizeCi({
   321	      checkRuns,
   322	      combinedStatus: combined,
   323	    });
   324	
   325	    // Reject accidental cross-SHA contamination if client returns tagged runs.
   326	    for (const run of checkRuns || []) {
   327	      if (run.head_sha && run.head_sha !== sha) {
   328	        throw new BuilderCoreError(
   329	          `CI check run head_sha ${run.head_sha} does not match candidate ${sha}`,
   330	          'CI_SHA_MISMATCH'
   331	        );
   332	      }
   333	    }
   334	
   335	    lastEvidence = buildCiEvidence({
   336	      candidate,
   337	      sha,
   338	      pr,
   339	      summary,
   340	      checkRuns,
   341	      started_at,
   342	      polls,
   343	      outcome: null,
   344	    });
   345	
   346	    core.store.updateCandidate(candidate_id, {
   347	      pr_number: pr.number,
   348	      pr_url: pr.html_url,
   349	      pr_ref: String(pr.number),
   350	      ci_status: summary.ci_status,
   351	      ci_conclusion: summary.ci_conclusion,
   352	      ci_ref: JSON.stringify(lastEvidence),
   353	      evidence_at: summary.captured_at,
   354	    });
   355	
   356	    core.store.appendEvent({
   357	      task_id: candidate.task_id,
   358	      factory_run_id: candidate.factory_run_id,
   359	      event_type: EVENT_TYPE.CI_WAIT_PROGRESS,
   360	      payload: {
   361	        candidate_id,
   362	        commit_sha: sha,
   363	        pr_number: pr.number,
   364	        ci_status: summary.ci_status,
   365	        ci_conclusion: summary.ci_conclusion,
   366	        polls,
   367	        check_run_ids: lastEvidence.check_run_ids,
   368	        captured_at: summary.captured_at,
   369	      },
   370	    });
   371	
   372	    const classified = classifyCiSummary(summary);
   373	    if (classified.terminal) {
   374	      const finished_at = nowIso();
   375	      const evidence = {
   376	        ...lastEvidence,
   377	        finished_at,
   378	        outcome: classified.outcome,
   379	      };
   380	      core.store.updateCandidate(candidate_id, {
   381	        ci_ref: JSON.stringify(evidence),
   382	        evidence_at: finished_at,
   383	      });
   384	      core.store.appendEvent({
   385	        task_id: candidate.task_id,
   386	        factory_run_id: candidate.factory_run_id,
   387	        event_type: EVENT_TYPE.CI_WAIT_FINISHED,
   388	        payload: evidence,
   389	      });
   390	      return {
   391	        outcome: classified.outcome,
   392	        evidence,
   393	        candidate: core.store.getCandidate(candidate_id),
   394	      };
   395	    }
   396	
   397	    const remaining = deadline - nowFn();
   398	    if (remaining <= 0) break;
   399	    await sleepFn(Math.min(poll_ms, remaining));
   400	  }
   401	
   402	  const finished_at = nowIso();
   403	  const evidence = {
   404	    ...(lastEvidence ||
   405	      buildCiEvidence({
   406	        candidate,
   407	        sha: boundSha,
   408	        pr: null,
   409	        summary: { ci_status: 'pending', ci_conclusion: null },
   410	        checkRuns: [],
   411	        started_at,
   412	        polls,
   413	      })),
   414	    finished_at,
   415	    outcome: CI_WAIT_OUTCOME.TIMEOUT,
   416	  };
   417	  core.store.updateCandidate(candidate_id, {
   418	    ci_ref: JSON.stringify(evidence),
   419	    evidence_at: finished_at,
   420	  });
   421	  core.store.appendEvent({
   422	    task_id: candidate.task_id,
   423	    factory_run_id: candidate.factory_run_id,
   424	    event_type: EVENT_TYPE.CI_WAIT_FINISHED,
   425	    payload: evidence,
   426	  });
   427	  return {
   428	    outcome: CI_WAIT_OUTCOME.TIMEOUT,
   429	    evidence,
   430	    candidate: core.store.getCandidate(candidate_id),
   431	  };
   432	}
